Chapter 762: Chapter 37 Pushing The Door Open (Request For Subscription)_3

Chapter 762: Chapter 37 Pushing the Door Open (Request for Subscription)_3

The term “Heaven’s Gate” here is broadly defined and does not specifically refer to the Heaven’s Gate before us; perhaps it refers to some other existence?

Rustling.

The Heaven’s Gate slowly opened.

Following a brief silence, the crowd of Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses around it burst into an uproar.

“Heaven’s Gate, Heaven’s Gate has been pushed open.”

“I knew it, Heaven’s Gate could definitely be pushed open, last time was just an accident.”

...

…

The many exhilarated Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses chatted among themselves, knowing that even though the Heaven’s Gate could be opened, most of them would still not be able to enter.

But at the very least, they could obtain rare items through the Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who did enter the gate.

Even if most of those items were to be taken by this particular Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouse, it was still far better than being left in the Two-dimensional World.

“Heaven’s Gate!”

New confidence surged in the eyes of the Four Divine Kings.

With Lin Yuan here, his chance to enter the Heaven’s Gate this time was nonexistent, but next time, once Lin Yuan had left, who else in the entire Two-dimensional World could compete with him for a position at the next Heaven’s Gate?

…

Before the Heaven’s Gate.

Lin Yuan did not step in immediately.

The different difficulties in opening the Heaven’s Gate twice made Lin Yuan develop other thoughts about what was inside it.

“Since it’s been pushed,”

After contemplating for a moment, Lin Yuan turned back to look at the excited human Evolvers and then stepped in with his right foot.

If this Two-dimensional World were truly governed by some Spirit Will that could easily alter the difficulty of opening the Heaven’s Gate, then whether Lin Yuan stepped in or not was meaningless.

As of now, the Heaven’s Gate was his only hope of escape, and no matter his apprehensions, he had to enter.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan stepped inside the Heaven’s Gate.

Immediately after turning tangible, the Heaven’s Gate began to slowly close, fading away.

The tumultuous force of the spatial energy at the summit of Heavenly Mountain quickly settled as if it had never existed.

…

Cosmic Starry Sky.

At the moment Lin Yuan pushed open the Heaven’s Gate,

Xia Qin Supreme Being and other nine Supreme Beings of human civilization stood ready, activating their Clan Suppression Weapon, ready to envelop Lin Yuan the moment he appeared.

Other Ultimate entities could not sense Lin Yuan’s presence through the Clan Suppression Weapon.

Thus, the greatest secret about Blood Rain was preserved.

As the aura of the nine Supreme Beings from human civilization spread, other Ultimate entities also cooperated extremely well, withdrawing their perception and focusing solely on “White Paper” itself.

Time passed.

Xia Qin Supreme Being and the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization immediately sensed that something was amiss.

Because until the Heaven’s Gate reclosed and faded away, they had detected no spatial fluctuations outside the canvas, let alone found any trace of Lin Yuan.

“What’s going on?”

“Where’s ‘Blood Rain’?”

“Didn’t he enter the Heaven’s Gate? Why hasn’t he appeared yet?”

Not only were the nine Supreme Beings of human civilization confused, but the other Ultimate entities also felt that something was wrong.

“The space fluctuation stirred by the Heaven’s Gate manifested in the Two-dimensional World within White Paper, isn’t it a spatial channel leading to the outer world?”

“If it doesn’t transport to the outer world, then where does it lead?”

The many Supreme Beings furrowed their brows, wondering whether Lin Yuan could successfully leave the Two-dimensional World, a concern not only for human civilization.

It was also a concern for many Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses still in the Two-dimensional World.

If Lin Yuan entered the Heaven’s Gate but did not return to the Main Universe, didn’t that mean that when the Heaven’s Gate was opened again, other Myriad Tribes’ Powerhouses who pushed open the Heaven’s Gate would still be unable to return to the Main Universe?

“Xia Qin, where has ‘Blood Rain’ gone after entering the Heaven’s Gate?”

“Yeah, Xia Qin, if he has not escaped the Two-dimensional World’s constraints, where does that Heaven’s Gate actually lead?”

One of the Ultimate entities immediately turned to Xia Qin Supreme Being and asked.

Since Blood Rain came from human civilization, Xia Qin Supreme Being could definitely contact his True Body.

Thus, it was vital to determine the current whereabouts of Blood Rain who had entered the Heaven’s Gate.

And this was something that many Ultimate entities at the scene were eager to know.

“What’s the rush?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being, with furrowed brows, glanced at the other Ultimate entities and did not immediately try to contact Lin Yuan.

Although unclear about the specific location within the Heaven’s Gate,

Xia Qin Supreme Being speculated that it must be a crucial place.

Lin Yuan needed to gather his energy to cope.

Contacting him now and disturbing Lin Yuan was not a good thing.

Xia Qin Supreme Being believed that once Lin Yuan had a moment to adjust, he would take the initiative to contact him.

…..

After Lin Yuan stepped inside the Heaven’s Gate, he quickly felt his Spirit Will being elevated, supporting a shift from two-dimensional to three-dimensional space.

At the same time, Lin Yuan also became more aware that he was detaching from some world—a vast, boundless giant canvas containing a broad and vast cosmos, from which he was rapidly escaping.

“Is that the Two-dimensional World I fell into?” Lin Yuan immediately realized that the giant painting was the Two-dimensional World that had trapped him for over ten thousand years.

“The feeling of ascension… the feeling of descent…” Lin Yuan felt it very peculiar; when drawn into the painting, he hadn’t had the chance to fully perceive what being demoted meant.

But now, extricating from the giant painting and becoming a normal life form again provided a clear experience.

“Hmm?”

Lin Yuan carefully felt for a while, then his expression subtly changed.

Because he then discovered that although he had escaped the Two-dimensional World, he had not returned to the Main Universe.

“Where is this?”

Lin Yuan looked around. It was a vast space; further away was an infinite expanse of murky gas, with only the giant canvas standing out prominently.

At that moment, Lin Yuan also noticed an old man sitting in front of the giant canvas. In comparison to the canvas, this old man was extremely ‘tiny,’ only half a meter tall, which was why Lin Yuan had initially ignored him.

While Lin Yuan was observing the half-meter-tall old man, this old man was also looking at Lin Yuan with a peculiar gaze, continuously sizing him up.
